description: This file defines the ClientStub class, which provides an interface for IPC communication testing, including methods for connecting, disconnecting, sending requests, and handling events related to a mock client in a test environment.

classes.name: ClientStub
classes.description: A class that acts as a stub for IPC client testing, providing methods to simulate client behavior and handle IPC events.

methods.name: ClientStub
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ClientStub with a mock client and socket name.

methods.name: ~ClientStub
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up ClientStub resources.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection for the client stub.

methods.name: sendSingleVarRequest
methods.description: Sends a request with a single variable.

methods.name: sendMultiVarRequest
methods.description: Sends a request with multiple variables.

methods.name: sendSingleVarRequestWithNoReply
methods.description: Sends a request expecting no reply.

methods.name: sendRequestWithSingleVarResponse
methods.description: Sends a request expecting a single variable response.

methods.name: sendRequestWithMultiVarResponse
methods.description: Sends a request expecting multiple variable responses.

methods.name: startMessageThread
methods.description: Starts a thread to listen for messages, optionally expecting a message.

methods.name: waitForSingleVarEvent
methods.description: Waits for a single variable event to be received.

methods.name: waitForMultiVarEvent
methods.description: Waits for a multi-variable event to be received.

methods.name: onTestEventSingleVarReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when a single variable test event is received.

methods.name: onTestEventMultiVarReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when a multi-variable test event is received.
